Covering Why James Gunn is Out DC Studios as Creative Chief Officer. James Gunn is no longer running DC Studios like Kevin Feige at Marvel. He is still finishing Superman 2 Man of Tomorrow, and said he has a contract to do Superman 3 (2029). And states a number of reasons why he wanted to leave his job as DC Studios Boss and go back to just making movies as a Director like Superman Man of Tomorrow. 

He says his characters will continue, David Corenswet Superman, John Stewart Green Lantern, Nathan Fillion Guy Gardner, the Justice Gang characters, other new character. But his 10 Year DCU Movie Plan will likely change and some other director and writer will do the next DCU Batman movie, and it might not be called Batman Brave and the Bold. And Damien Wayne might not be in it. 

And some other director and writer will do the new Justice League Movie. Jeremy Latcham from Marvel Studios is taking over as Creative Chief of DC Studios. He previously hired James Gunn to do Guardians of the Galaxy at Marvel and worked with Kevin Feige since the first Iron Man Movie.

All the current movies they're working on are still releasing.
The Batman 2 First Looks and new Footage. The Court of Owls. Sebastian Stan Victor Zasz, Bryan Tyree Henry Harvey Dent Two Face, Scarlett Johansson Poison Ivy. New Joker, Batman villain references and hidden details. The New Batman of the DCU. Batman Brave and the Bold, James Gunn interview breakdown. Superman 2 Man Of Tomorrow, Supergirl Trailer connection. Warner Bros Netflix Buyout Explained.

New Batman Easter Eggs and References during Lanterns Episodes. How Lanterns sets up The Batman Brave and the Bold Movie Teaser. Lanterns Episode 3 Trailer. Sinestro Explains The Yellow Power Of Fear to Hal Jordan and the Yellow Lantern Corps, the prophecy of Blackest Night and the War of Light. What happened to Sinestro, why Lanterns is setting up the Manhunters and the secret history of the Guardians of OA and the other emotional spectrum like yellow lanterns, red lanterns and more.

Matt Reeves plans for The Batman 2 and why The Batman 3 might not happen. Batman Brave and the Bold Changes and the New Batman will be announced next year. And more new Justice League characters in Man of Tomorrow. Lots more DC and Marvel Trailers coming, Avengers Doomsday Trailer & X-Men 2028 Teasers. And Superman 2 Man of Tomorrow Teasers.

snippet.description:
중국을 유럽에 올리면 어디까지 닿을까?

중국은 약 960만㎢로 남한의 96배쯤이고, 유럽연합 27개 나라를 다 합쳐도 절반이 되지 않아요. 그렇다면 러시아의 유럽 쪽까지 더한 유럽 위에 한가운데를 맞춰 올리면 어디까지 덮일까요? 지도 위에서 같은 크기 그대로 겹쳐 봤습니다.

#중국 #유럽 #지도 #크기비교 #유럽연합 #지도크기 #세계지도 #MAP썰

계산: 덮이는 넓이는 Natural Earth 경계로 직접 계산(유럽은 러시아 동경 60도 서쪽까지 978만㎢ 기준 약 64%, 유럽을 1,018만㎢로 잡으면 약 61%) · 해돋이 시각은 동지 무렵(12월 21일) 기준 계산값
그림·효과음: MAP썰 자체 제작 (시계·해·남한 모양 칸은 직접 그린 그림, 효과음은 직접 합성) · 사진·실제 영상 없음
사실: CIA 월드 팩트북(2026년 1월 마지막 판, 2026.2.4 서비스 종료) 중국 넓이·시간대, 한국경제(2026.3.30, 국토교통부 지적통계) 남한 넓이 100,472.4㎢, 유로스탯(2026) 유럽연합 넓이 4,225,104㎢, 유럽연합 누리집(2026.11.9 확인) 회원국 27개, sunrise-sunset.org 해 뜨는 시각 계산(카슈가르 10:12, 베이징 7:32), 위키백과 「Europe」·월드아틀라스 「Europe」(참고, 유럽 넓이는 자료마다 994만~1,019만㎢라 '약 1,000만㎢'로 말함), 표준국어대사전 「카슈가르」

snippet.description:

RESTRICTION SUMMARY:

ASSOCIATED PRESS
Jackson, Mississippi - 9 November 2026
++EDIT BEGINS ON A SOUNDBITE++
1. SOUNDBITE (English): Todd Blanche, United States Attorney General
“Today, I am pleased to announce that the Department of Justice is investing nearly 64 million dollars through our Model City Initiative in the city of Jackson, Mississippi. This figure, this $64 million, represents the commitment that the Department of Justice is investing and making to the City of Jackson, Mississippi, to help them fight violent crime and increase public safety.”
++SOUNDBITES SEPARATED BY WHITE FLASH++
2. SOUNDBITE (English): Todd Blanche, United States Attorney General
“There's no connection between what's happening in, in Mississippi with respect to recounts or counts and what we're doing today."
++SOUNDBITES SEPARATED BY WHITE FLASH++
3. SOUNDBITE (English): Todd Blanche, United States Attorney General
“So the funding that's announced today will, among other initiatives, expand patrol and investigative capacity, enhance prosecution capacity, build a real-time public safety center, deploy a drone fleet, and improve the city's technology and real-time crime fighting capabilities."
4. Wide of officials holding check
STORYLINE:
United States Attorney General Todd Blanche announced Monday that the city of Jackson, Mississippi would be one of four recipients of funding through the Model Cities Initiative.

This is a program being implemented to lower crime levels and increase public safety in the state by providing law enforcement with access to more resources and improved technology. 

The attorney general’s visit comes as Mississippi is still tallying ballots in the senate race between Democrat Scott Colom and Republican Sen. Cindy Hyde-Smith. 

The contest remains too early for The Associated Press to call, and Colom’s historic bid to be the first Black senator from this Deep South state since post-Civil War Reconstruction will hinge on a tedious process playing out in elections offices across Mississippi’s 82 counties. 

Local officials are receiving and examining absentee and provisional ballots, called affidavit ballots, before deadlines next week. 

Volunteers and lawyers representing each campaign are looking on in anticipation of potential litigation.
